kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انثقبت (form VII)
# اِنْثَقَبْتُ (inṯaqabtu) /in.θa.qab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْثَقَبَ (inṯaqaba)
# اِنْثَقَبْتَ (inṯaqabta) /in.θa.qab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْثَقَبَ (inṯaqaba)
# اِنْثَقَبْتِ (inṯaqabti) /in.θa.qab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْثَقَبَ (inṯaqaba)
# اِنْثَقَبَتْ (inṯaqabat) /in.θa.qa.bat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
